To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
PCAP is a novel technique that uses program counters to predict idle periods of I/O devices and can save energy in the operating system.

(1) PCAP is the first program-counter based shutdown predictor that predicts idle periods in the operating system, (2) PCAP achieves an average of 50% energy savings with 1.3% mispredictions for a wide range of applications, (3) PCAP is able to learn and predict idle periods across multiple executions of an application, and (4) PCAP can predict the idle periods of an application even if it is executed on a different machine.
